import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify soil and wilderness columns
soil_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col.startswith("Soil_Type")]
wild_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col.startswith("Wilderness_Area")]


# Engineer features: sum of soil types (dense soil indicator), wilderness combo
def add_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["Soil_Sum"] = df[soil_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["Wild_Sum"] = df[wild_cols].sum(axis=1)
    # Interaction: wilderness * soil density (high wilderness + low soil = rocky/high elevation)
    df["Wild_Soil_Interact"] = df["Wild_Sum"] * (10 - df["Soil_Sum"])
    # Ratio features for robustness
    df["Soil_Wild_Ratio"] = df["Soil_Sum"] / (df["Wild_Sum"] + 1e-5)
    return df


train_df = add_features(train_df)
test_df = add_features(test_df)

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # 0-indexed
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Split for validation (non-stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

# Create XGBoost DMatrix
train_data = xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)

# XGBoost parameters (unchanged from previous best)
params = {
    "objective": "multi:softprob",
    "num_class": 7,
    "eval_metric": "merror",
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 3,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_alpha": 0.01,
    "reg_lambda": 1.0,
    "seed": 42,
    "nthread": -1,
}

# Train model with early stopping
evals_result = {}
model = xgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    evals=[(train_data, "train"), (val_data, "val")],
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
    evals_result=evals_result,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_preds = model.predict(val_data)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_preds, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_data = xgb.DMatrix(X_test)
test_preds = model.predict(test_data)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_preds, axis=1) + 1  # Convert back to 1-indexed

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
